narr: A big push of monsoon moisture led to five days of scattered thunderstorms over the Mojave Desert and the Sierra. Many storms produced flash flooding and/or high winds.
ev: Main Street was flooded with water and debris.
Half an inch of rain in 15 minutes caused flooding of Dogwood Street between Minneola Road and Spyrock Avenue.
Water, rocks, and mud flooded the intersection of Old Fort Irwin Road and Old Highway 58.
Flash flooding caused mud and rock slides along Highway 168 near Aspendell, blocking the road and causing several vehicles to be stuck.
Lillyhill Drive was flooded six to eight inches deep near Bailey Avenue.
lsr: NWS SPOTTER REPORTED 0.5 INCHES OF RAIN IN THEIR GAUGE IN 15 MINUTES IN RAIN GAUGE WITH PONDING AND FLOODING OVER THE ROAD.
MUD FLOW AND ROCKSLIDES ARE OCCURRING AT SEVERAL LOCATIONS ALONG 168 NEAR ASPENDALE. DEBRIS IS BLOCKING THE ROAD AND SEVERAL VEHICLES ARE STUCK.
